engine.precClauseKey:
function precClauseKey(heading, agreementType) {
  var TAX = [
    ["governing_law", /governing law|applicable law|choice of law|law and jurisdiction/],
    ["venue", /\bvenue\b|jurisdiction|forum|courts?\b/],
    ["dispute_resolution", /dispute|arbitration|mediation|escalation/],
    ["insurance", /insurance/],
    ["limitation_of_liability", /limitation of liability|limitations? on liability|liability cap|exclusion of (?:damages|liability)|consequential damages|\bliability\b/],
    ["indemnification", /indemn|hold harmless/],
    ["confidentiality", /confidential|non-?disclosure|proprietary information/],
    ["intellectual_property", /intellectual property|\bip\b|ownership|inventions?|license|licen[cs]e|patents?|background ip/],
    ["publication", /publication|publish/],
    ["publicity", /publicity|use of (?:the )?names?|press release|trademarks?/],
    ["payment", /payment|fees?\b|invoic|compensation|price|pricing|expenses?/],
    ["term_termination", /\bterm\b|terminat|duration|renewal|expiration/],
    ["warranties", /warrant|representations?/],
    ["data_protection", /data protection|personal data|privacy|gdpr|data security/],
    ["audit", /audit|records|inspection/],
    ["assignment", /assign|transfer of (?:the )?agreement|change of control/],
    ["notices", /\bnotices?\b/],
    ["force_majeure", /force majeure|acts? of god/],
    ["compliance", /compliance|anti-?(?:bribery|corruption)|export|sanctions|code of conduct/],
    ["independent_contractor", /independent contractor|relationship of the parties|no agency/],
    ["non_solicitation", /non-?solicit|non-?hire|non-?compet/],
    ["subcontracting", /subcontract/],
    ["survival", /surviv/],
    ["entire_agreement", /entire agreement|integration|amendments?|modifications?|waiver/],
    ["severability", /severab/],
    ["counterparts", /counterparts|electronic signature|execution/],
  ];
  var h = String(heading || "").toLowerCase().replace(/^(?:article|section|clause)\s+[\divxlc.]+\s*/i, "").replace(/[^a-z0-9 -]+/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  for (var i = 0; i < TAX.length; i++) if (TAX[i][1].test(h)) return { key: TAX[i][0], general: true };
  return { key: String(agreementType || "Unknown") + ": " + (h || "(untitled)"), general: false };
}
